title: Implement frontend integration with test-connection endpoint
description: Integrate the frontend connection form with the backend test-connection endpoint, displaying success or failure to the user.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend calls test-connection endpoint on connection attempt
Success is displayed to user on valid connection
Descriptive error is displayed to user on invalid connection

evidence: src/connection/connectionApi.ts — changed DEFAULT_API_URL from '/api/connections' to '/api/v1/connections/test' (TASK-052 backend endpoint)
src/App.tsx — integrated ConnectionForm into the React app via useRef/useEffect, mounted in a connection-panel section
src/index.css — added connection panel and form styles (panel layout, inputs, submit button, success/error status colors)

src/__tests__/connectionApi.test.ts — updated default URL assertion to '/api/v1/connections/test'; added integration test suite (4 tests) verifying form calls test-connection endpoint, success status displayed on valid connection, descriptive error on invalid connection (401), descriptive error on network failure

src/connection/connectionApi.ts — DEFAULT_API_URL '/api/v1/connections/test' (TASK-052 backend endpoint); proper error handling for non-ok responses, JSON body parsing with fallback to statusText, network error catch, test hooks (setFetchForTesting/resetFetchForTesting)

src/connection/ConnectionForm.ts — semantic form with accessibility (role='status', aria-live='polite', for/id label associations, type='password'), loading state (disabled button, aria-busy), input validation (required fields, port min/max), dependency-injected submitConnection for testability, destroy() cleanup
src/App.tsx — imperative mounting via useRef/useEffect with proper cleanup on unmount (form.destroy()), mounted in connection-panel section
